description: Practice two prepositions with clearly differentiated meanings in each item.

questions.sentence: ___ class, Emi stood ___ her classmates.

questions.japanese: 授業後、エミはクラスメートたちの中に立っていた。

questions.sentence: ___ a staff shortage, Mika worked ___ a guide.

questions.sentence: ___ a road closure, we traveled ___ Nagoya.

questions.japanese: 病院の向かいにある薬局は、駅から徒歩5分以内である。

questions.sentence: ___ the students, everyone ___ Ken passed.

questions.japanese: 学生の中では、ケンを除く全員が合格した。

questions.sentence: The delivery truck drives ___ the warehouse six times ___ day.

questions.japanese: 配送トラックは1日6回倉庫に入る。

questions.sentence: ___ team leader, she sent the update ___ email.
questions.completedSentence: As team leader, she sent the update via email.
questions.japanese: チームリーダーとして、彼女はメールで最新情報を送った。

questions.sentence: ___ the approaching deadline, finish the task ___ one hour.
questions.completedSentence: Because of the approaching deadline, finish the task within one hour.
questions.japanese: 締め切りが迫っているため、1時間以内に作業を終えること。

questions.sentence: ___ the bell rang, the students went ___ the classroom.

questions.japanese: ベルが鳴った後、学生たちは教室に入った。

questions.sentence: ___ the applicants, the finalists were selected ___ online interviews.
questions.completedSentence: Among the applicants, the finalists were selected via online interviews.
questions.japanese: 応募者の中から、オンライン面接によって最終候補者が選ばれた。

questions.sentence: All the stores ___ the café ___ the station were closed.
questions.completedSentence: All the stores except for the café opposite the station were closed.
questions.japanese: 駅の向かいにあるカフェを除き、すべての店が閉まっていた。

questions.sentence: Three buses ___ hour operate ___ the city center.
questions.completedSentence: Three buses per hour operate within the city center.
questions.japanese: 市中心部では1時間に3本のバスが運行している。

questions.sentence: ___ the meeting, Ken remained ___ the volunteers.
questions.completedSentence: After the meeting, Ken remained among the volunteers.
questions.japanese: 会議後、ケンはボランティアたちの中に残った。

questions.sentence: ___ the rain, the gym was used ___ the event venue.
questions.completedSentence: Because of the rain, the gym was used as the event venue.
questions.japanese: 雨のため、体育館が行事会場として使われた。

questions.sentence: ___ holidays, the clinic sees 40 patients ___ day.
questions.completedSentence: Except for holidays, the clinic sees 40 patients per day.
questions.japanese: 休日を除き、その診療所は1日40人の患者を診察する。

questions.sentence: He drove ___ a garage ___ the library.

questions.japanese: 彼は図書館の向かいにある車庫へ車で入った。

questions.sentence: ___ you submit the form, you will receive a reply ___ two days.
questions.completedSentence: After you submit the form, you will receive a reply within two days.
questions.japanese: 用紙を提出した後、2日以内に返事が届く。

questions.sentence: ___ the canceled direct flight, we flew ___ Seoul.
questions.completedSentence: Because of the canceled direct flight, we flew via Seoul.
questions.japanese: 直行便が欠航したため、ソウル経由で飛んだ。

questions.sentence: The café ___ the library is ___ the campus grounds.
questions.completedSentence: The café opposite the library is within the campus grounds.
questions.japanese: 図書館の向かいにあるカフェはキャンパス内にある。

questions.sentence: ___ these books, all ___ the dictionary are new.

questions.japanese: これらの本の中では、辞書を除くすべてが新品である。

questions.sentence: Visitors move ___ the hall at a rate of 200 ___ hour.

questions.japanese: 来場者は1時間に200人の割合でホールに入る。

questions.sentence: ___ our guide, Ken communicated with us ___ an app.
questions.completedSentence: As our guide, Ken communicated with us via an app.
questions.japanese: 私たちのガイドとして、ケンはアプリを通じて連絡を取った。

questions.sentence: ___ the storm, everyone moved indoors ___ ten minutes.
questions.completedSentence: Because of the storm, everyone moved indoors within ten minutes.
questions.japanese: 嵐のため、全員が10分以内に屋内へ移動した。

questions.sentence: ___ the rain stopped, the children ran ___ the park.

questions.japanese: 雨がやんだ後、子どもたちは公園へ走って入った。

questions.sentence: ___ the entries, the winner was chosen ___ an online vote.

questions.sentence: Two deliveries ___ day are made ___ the campus.

questions.sentence: ___ the ceremony, the teacher walked ___ the guests.

questions.sentence: ___ the captain's absence, Ken served ___ team leader.

questions.sentence: ___ August, the museum holds two tours ___ week.

questions.sentence: The child ran ___ a shop ___ the bank.

questions.sentence: ___ the train arrived, we reached the hotel ___ ten minutes.

questions.sentence: ___ repairs to the bridge, the bus went ___ the coastal road.

questions.japanese: エレベーターの向かいにある事務室は入口から20メートル以内にある。

questions.sentence: ___ the shops, all ___ the café close at six.

questions.sentence: A train pulls ___ the station four times ___ hour.

questions.sentence: ___ treasurer, Emi paid the fee ___ bank transfer.

questions.sentence: ___ limited seating, register ___ two days.

questions.sentence: ___ the doors opened, the crowd moved ___ the hall.

questions.sentence: ___ the available routes, we found the shortest one ___ a navigation app.

questions.japanese: 利用可能な経路の中から、ナビアプリを使って最短経路を見つけた。

questions.sentence: All the apartments ___ the one ___ the park were rented.

questions.sentence: ___ lunch, Aya sat ___ her friends.
